post.description: A correct password emails a one-time code to the admin; it does not open a session. Wrong passwords count toward the lockout (429 while locked). Asking again inside `resendAfterSeconds` does not send another code.

expiresAt.description: The emailed code stops working at this instant.

resendAfterSeconds.description: Seconds before another code is emailed.

post.description: The right code opens the session (once). Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), 429 while locked. A wrong code counts toward the same lockout as a wrong password.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh and expires after the idle timeout without one.

post.description: Keeps an active session alive. A session idle for longer than `admin.sessionIdleSec` has an expired refresh token (401); reusing an old token ends the session.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh and expires after the idle timeout without one.

post.description: Revokes the refresh token. Always succeeds for a well-formed token.
